lines.text: Food that makes you feel better.
Warm soup is my comfort food.

data.mean: Food that makes you feel better.
data.define: Simple food that makes you feel better and at home.

example.text: Warm soup is my comfort food.

misuse.text: Don't call hospital food your 'comfort food'.
misuse.why: It means food that cozily soothes you.

data.l1_hook: Trauriger Tag? Eine warme Suppe ist dein 'comfort food'!
